# lcd.getContrastingColor

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Get the contrasting color for a given background.

```lua
local color = lcd.getContrastingColor(color)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | integer | yes |  |

## Returns

color (integer): the contrasting color
